verdicts.title: On the unitary representation theory of locally compact contraction groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The unitary representation theory of locally compact contraction groups and their semi-direct products with $\mathbb{Z}$ is studied. verdicts.title: Integral means inequalities, convolution, and univalent functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We use the Baernstein star-function to investigate several questions about the integral means of the convolution of two analytic functions in the unit disc. The theory of univalent functions plays a basic role in our work.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns integral means, convolution, and univalent functions in the unit disc via the Baernstein star-function — entirely unrelated to symmetric function rank, Tseitin resolution trees, or proof complexity width.
